sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Bây giờ thì ổn rồi, cảm ơn bạn closes a helpful exchange warmly. It is short enough for a beginner and works after directions, service help, a purchase, or a small kindness.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Use the complete line: Bây giờ thì ổn rồi, cảm ơn bạn. Keep the situation visible, pause after the phrase, and let the other person answer with a smile, acknowledgment, or short reply.
